messages:
maria: heads-up — dashboard p99 for /v1/generate jumped to ~4.8s in the global latency view but when I drill into endpoints the endpoint rows all show ~1.2s p99. Anyone seen this mismatch?
jon: hmm that's odd, are you looking at the aggregated view or the per-endpoint table?
maria: aggregated view (overview -> latency by route). per-endpoint table is the route breakdown panel on the same dashboard.
jon: could be an aggregation window mismatch (overview uses 5m ttl buckets, table uses 1m). or tdigest vs hdr bucket differences.
ashok: also remember we recently rolled a routing change that sends 10% traffic to dedicated-pool-b for canary — that pool is running an older runtime with slightly larger tails. if the aggregator pulls from a different ingestion shard it can skew the global p99.
eva: can you paste the query you used? I want to compare the two panels' SQL.
maria: here's the panel query (overview):
```sql
SELECT quantileExact(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99
FROM requests_global_v2
WHERE route = '/v1/generate' AND ts >= now() - interval 5 minute
```
and the table: 
```sql
SELECT route, quantileTDigest(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99
FROM requests_by_route
WHERE ts >= now() - interval 1 minute
GROUP BY route
```
jon: there it is — overview uses quantileExact on the global stream + 5m window; table uses t-digest on per-route smaller windows. quantileExact will be sensitive to skew from a small subset of shards.
ashok: also note requests_by_route is populated upstream after routing resolution; requests_global_v2 is an ingest of raw rpc logs that includes internal retries and healthcheck probes. those extra samples can widen tails.
maria: ah, retries. I did see a spike in retry_count around the same time.
eva: two action items: 1) standardize quantile function across these panels (pick tdigest for dashboard perf), 2) exclude internal retry/healthcheck labels from the global summary.
jon: agree. also add a note on the rollout page that canary traffic can temporarily inflate global percentiles if sampling for the global view pulls from the canary-friendly shard.
observability-bot: deploy-canary: canary rollout 2026-03-18T14:05 started for service infer-runtime -> dedicated-pool-b (10%).
maria: perfect, that matches the spike timestamp. I'll update the dashboard queries and add a small note in the rollout doc.
ashok: for long-term, we should align the ingestion stream schemas so the same aggregated metric is used by both panels (avoid duplicate sources). filing a ticket.
eva: filed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1429 — 'dashboard: unify p50/p95/p99 sources and quantile impl'
maria: assigning to @ashok to scrub historical drift for the past 48h and confirm whether the canary caused the 95/99 drift vs an actual perf regression.
ashok: on it, will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
jon: thanks — also maybe display a small badge on overview when the route-level and global p99 diverge > 20% so SREs notice quickly. cc @product-observability
maria: yep, UX suggestion noted. thanks all.
